reason: I already delete those settlement emails because they look like scams, and a free beta site that wants me to make an account so it can store my identity is the same thing. I'm not handing lawsuitai.org my details just to click through and fill out a form somewhere else.
objection: I don't want a startup storing my identity details. That is the whole play with these free-money sites, and I am not signing up for it.
would_change_my_mind: If I could browse listings and open the official administrator form with no account and no personal info stored, and a bank or retailer I actually use sent me there instead of some random site.
